settings_reset_factory_confirm.zh_cn: 恢复出厂设置将删除内部存储中的全部用户内容，包括设置、已安装应用及其数据。当前未包含 TF 卡。是否继续？
settings_reset_factory_confirm.en_us: Factory reset deletes all user content in internal storage, including settings, installed apps and their data. No TF card is included. Continue?

settings_reset_factory_card_confirm.zh_cn: 恢复出厂设置将删除内部存储中的全部用户内容，包括设置、已安装应用及其数据，并删除当前 TF 卡上的受管应用及其数据。TF 卡上的普通文件保留。是否继续？
settings_reset_factory_card_confirm.en_us: Factory reset deletes all user content in internal storage, including settings, installed apps and their data, plus managed apps and their data on the current TF card. Ordinary TF files are kept. Continue?

settings_reset_network_confirm.zh_cn: 重置 WLAN 和蓝牙将清除已保存的 WLAN 网络及蓝牙配对，并恢复无线连接设置。是否继续？
settings_reset_network_confirm.en_us: Reset WLAN and Bluetooth clears saved WLAN networks and Bluetooth pairings, and restores wireless connection settings. Continue?

settings_reset_card_confirm.zh_cn: 格式化当前 TF 卡（容量 %s）将删除卡上的全部文件。是否继续？
settings_reset_card_confirm.en_us: Formatting the current TF card (capacity %s) deletes every file on the card. Continue?

settings_reset_wait_card.zh_cn: 等待原 TF 卡，请插入后重试
settings_reset_wait_card.en_us: Waiting for the original TF card. Insert it and retry.

settings_reset_partial.zh_cn: 内部存储已重置，TF 卡尚未完成
settings_reset_partial.en_us: Internal storage reset. TF card cleanup is incomplete.

settings_reset_finish.zh_cn: 保留 TF 卡并结束重置
settings_reset_finish.en_us: Keep TF card and finish reset

settings_reset_finish_confirm.zh_cn: 内部存储已重置。结束重置将保留原 TF 卡上尚未清理的受管应用数据。确认保留 TF 卡并结束重置？
settings_reset_finish_confirm.en_us: Internal storage has been reset. Finishing now keeps any managed app data still on the original TF card. Keep the TF card and finish reset?

settings_reset_ended.zh_cn: 已结束重置，TF 卡已保留

reading_fonts_choose.zh_cn: 从 TF 卡选择字体
reading_fonts_choose.en_us: Choose a font on TF card

reading_fonts_result_missing.zh_cn: 任务结果已不在记录中，请查看字体列表确认。
reading_fonts_result_missing.en_us: This task result is no longer retained. Check the font list to confirm.

reading_fonts_request_failed.zh_cn: 无法执行字体操作，请检查存储状态后重试。
reading_fonts_request_failed.en_us: The font operation could not start. Check storage and retry.

reading_fonts_delete_active.zh_cn: 此字体正在使用。删除后，阅读正文将改用内置 MiSans。是否继续？
reading_fonts_delete_active.en_us: This font is currently used. Deleting it switches reading text to built-in MiSans. Continue?

reading_fonts_checking_glyphs.zh_cn: 正在检查样文中的字符。

reading_fonts_fallback.zh_cn: 此字体缺少部分样文字符，缺字使用内置字体后备。
reading_fonts_fallback.en_us: Some sample characters are missing and use built-in fallback fonts.

reading_fonts_preview_only.zh_cn: 预览不会改变当前阅读字体。
reading_fonts_preview_only.en_us: Previewing does not change the current reading font.

reading_fonts_preview_unavailable.zh_cn: 暂时无法预览此字体，请检查存储状态或稍后重试。
reading_fonts_preview_unavailable.en_us: This font cannot be previewed now. Check storage or try again later.

reading_fonts_format.zh_cn: 支持含 TrueType 轮廓的静态 .ttf 字体。
reading_fonts_format.en_us: Static .ttf fonts with TrueType outlines are supported.

reading_fonts_empty.zh_cn: 此目录没有子目录或 .ttf 文件。
reading_fonts_empty.en_us: This folder has no subfolders or .ttf files.

reading_fonts_browse_failed.zh_cn: 无法读取目录，请检查 TF 卡并刷新。
reading_fonts_browse_failed.en_us: Cannot read this folder. Check the TF card and refresh.

reading_fonts_space.zh_cn: 可用空间如下，中文字体推荐使用 TF 卡。
reading_fonts_space.en_us: Available space is shown. Use the TF card for full Chinese fonts.

reading_fonts_source_changed.zh_cn: 原 TF 卡已断开，请返回并重新选择文件。
reading_fonts_source_changed.en_us: The source TF card disconnected. Go back and choose the file again.

settings_name_bluetooth_failed.zh_cn: 设备名称已保存，蓝牙名称更新失败
settings_name_bluetooth_failed.en_us: Device name saved; Bluetooth name update failed

settings_name_invalid.zh_cn: 请输入有效的设备名称
